body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.68 (naive base rate 0.60) that: Honasa Consumer Q3 FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥12.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (6-Nov-2026): net sales +36%, UVG 31.3%, EBITDA margin 12.7%; H1 ~13.5% incl. a Q1 one-off. CEO Varun Alagh on raising the 150–200 bps improvement guidance: 'I have not seen any benefits of being too aggressive. Conservative probably the better place to be'; for H2 'confident of being able to hold our current trajectory… around 12.5'. Festive A&P accelerated in Q3. Screener OPM: Dec-25 11%, Mar-26 12%, Jun-26 15%, Sep-26 13%. (Company had an FY25 distributor-inventory correction — see company:HONASA.) Reasoning: After the FY25 credibility hit, management now under-promises; the ~12.5% H2 guide with Q2 at 12.7% and operating leverage at +30% volume growth gives cushion even with festive A&P. Resolution: YES if Q3 FY27 consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales on screener.in ≥12.0% (company-reported EBITDA margin used if screener unavailable). Source: screener.in Honasa consolidated quarterly; Honasa Q3 FY27 results presentation. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Persistence: a margin ~0.7 pt above a threshold stays above it next quarter ~60% for a young consumer brand with volatile A&P.
